name: Regime ordinario, 18,000 revenue and 3,000 costs: the self-employment detrazione's 50-euro bonus
workings: A freelancer outside forfettario (regime ordinario), e.g. after leaving it: TUIR art. 13 c. 5 and 5-bis
Gestione Separata on all of it: 26.07% × 15,000.00 = 3,910.50; below the 18,808 minimum base, so 12 × 15,000 / 18,808 = 9.57, i.e. 9 months count
Total income R = 15,000.00; taxable after deducting the contributions: 15,000.00 − 3,910.50 = 11,089.50
Bonus (c. 5-bis, L. 234/2021): + 50, as R = 15,000 is above 11,000 and not above 17,000; detrazione = 992.00
Net IRPEF: 2,550.585 − 992.00 = 1,558.585 (no cuneo for the self-employed)
